newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air sets free flight promotion.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air sets free flight promotion.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said Tuesday it is offering a promotion that allows companions to fly free when accompanying passengers buying certain fares between 16 cities in the eastern and midwestern U.S. and Florida.

The fares are available from Atlanta, Chicago, Columbus (Ohio), Fort Lauderdale, Fort Walton Beach, Jacksonville, Louisville, Memphis, New Orleans, Norlfolk, Orlando, Philadelphia, Raleigh-Durham, Savannah, Tampa, Washington and West Palm Beach, the company said.
Passengers must buy tickets by January 31 for travel through February 13, the company said.
